scope: Static extraction from local WCD9378 datasheet and ELIZA schematic only; Gerrit patch content unavailable without authentication.

title_hits: SCHEMATIC, CCA, EVK AUDIO DC, WCD9378, 2XWSA884X

interfaces.soundwire: SoundWire access to on-chip digital audio channels with 1.2V/1.8V support; Tx and Rx SoundWire peripherals with two data lanes each.

audio_capability.tx_rx_ports: Four analog input Tx ports and four analog output Rx ports; three ADCs and four DACs.
audio_capability.outputs: Earpiece, stereo HPH PA, and AUX PA are described as analog output ports.

pin_mapping.reset_pin: RESET_N is pin 33 and described as WCD9378 IC level reset.
pin_mapping.rx_swr_pins: SWR_RX_CLK pin 19, SWR_RX_DATA0 pin 28, SWR_RX_DATA1 pin 10.
pin_mapping.tx_swr_pins: SWR_TX_CLK pin 20, SWR_TX_DATA0 pin 15, SWR_TX_DATA1 pin 16.

mic_bias.description: Three microphone bias voltage sources, programmable from 1.05V to 2.85V in 50mV steps; normal operation typ 1.8V and max 2.85V.

device_identification.chip_id_bytes: WCD9378 sample table shows CHIP_ID_BYTE_0..3 as 0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x01 for ES/CS rows.
device_identification.pm_note: This is useful but does not by itself prove Linux SoundWire SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY manufacturer/part/class values; runtime/sysfs/modalias evidence remains required.
